name: notes
description: Persistente Notizen (add/list) in der plugin-eigenen SQLite-DB, getrennt von der Hauptdatenbank.

action.description: add = Notiz speichern, list = letzte Notizen

script: const s = toolContext.storage; if (!s) return { error: 'plugin storage not enabled' }; await s.exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, text TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)'); if (toolInput.action === 'add') { const text = String(toolInput.text || '').trim(); if (!text) return { error: 'text is required for action=add' }; await s.exec('INSERT INTO notes (text, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)', [text, new Date().toISOString()]); return { added: true, text }; } const rows = await s.query('SELECT id, text, created_at FROM notes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20'); return { count: rows.length, notes: rows };
